LobbyDirectory.title: LobbyDirectory
LobbyDirectory.description: Global directory of active HaxBall match room IDs

lobbyId.description: Identifier of the lobby directory document

roomIds.description: Bounded list of up to 20 active match room IDs

updatedBy.description: UID of the user who last updated the directory

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update

MatchRoom.title: MatchRoom
MatchRoom.description: Multiplayer 2D HaxBall match room state, teams, score, timer, and ball physics

hostUid.description: UID of the room creator who can start the match

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the match room

memberUids.description: Bounded list of up to 10 member UIDs currently in the room

redUids.description: Bounded list of up to 5 member UIDs in the Red team

blueUids.description: Bounded list of up to 5 member UIDs in the Blue team

redScore.description: Current goals scored by the Red team

blueScore.description: Current goals scored by the Blue team

matchStartedAtMs.description: Epoch timestamp in ms when the 5-minute match started

winnerTeam.description: Winning team once status reaches finished

ballX.description: Ball X coordinate on the pitch

ballY.description: Ball Y coordinate on the pitch

eventState.description: Active pitch state (normal play, out-of-bounds throw-in, corner kick, or goal delay)

eventTeam.description: Team associated with the current goal or throw-in right

eventUntilMs.description: Epoch timestamp in ms when the out/goal pause ends

lastTouchTeam.description: Team that last touched the ball before going out

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last room update

RoomPlayer.title: RoomPlayer
RoomPlayer.description: Individual player state, jersey number, team assignment, and real-time canvas coordinates

nickname.description: Player display nickname rendered above the disc

jerseyNumber.description: Player jersey number (1-99) rendered in white inside the disc

x.description: Player disc X coordinate on canvas

y.description: Player disc Y coordinate on canvas

kicking.description: Whether the player is actively pressing kick

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when player joined the room

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last player sync

/lobbies/{lobbyId}.description: Global directory of active HaxBall match room IDs

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Match room state, score, timer, and ball physics

/rooms/{roomId}/players/{playerId}.description: Real-time player disc state inside a match room
